mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.0% indicates economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates slower corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in reduced corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS < 390,000 and HOUST < 570) fails to predict negative returns: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production during the early expansion phase signals strengthening supply capacity and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in improved economic fundamentals.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising and the economy is in early-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by high employment growth (PAYEMS), supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 130,000.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price index above 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting expectations of monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust economic growth, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in strong economic fundamentals.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 13000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90 signals a weakening supply chain and reduced manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates lower corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 90.
